description: This Java source file defines the AdminClient class responsible for communicating with a running OFBiz server instance through network socket commands such as status requests and shutdown commands. It contains methods for sending commands and handling socket communication with the server.

classes.name: AdminClient
classes.description: A utility class that facilitates communication with an OFBiz server via socket commands for status checks and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: requestStatus
methods.description: Sends a status request command to the OFBiz server and returns the server's current status or error messages.

methods.name: requestShutdown
methods.description: Sends a shutdown command to the OFBiz server and returns the server's response or error message.

methods.name: sendSocketCommand
methods.description: Establishes socket connection to the server and exchanges command and response messages.
